Proposed windows (PT):
- Tuesday, Aug 10 — 10:00–11:30

Hi all — locking Wed Aug 11, 10:00–11:30 PT. Calendar invite has been sent (see link below).

Final attendee list and roles:
- Oliver Green — Eng lead (Atlas)
- Priya Sharma — Product Manager (Atlas)
- Backend engineer (Atlas) — TBD
- Camila Reyes — Solutions Engineer (Redwood)
- Marissa Cole — Customer Success (Redwood)
- Karthik Iyer — Account Executive (Redwood)
- Laura Bennett — Product Sponsor (Redwood)

Success criteria for the session (agreed):
1) Confirm prompt templates for core flows and validate top-3 prompt variants with team
2) Demonstrate routing fallback behavior for cost/latency trade-offs
3) Run a 5–10 minute synthetic load at the target QPS and capture p50/p95 latencies and per-token cost
4) Agree on next steps for a ~24–48 hour load window if Atlas wants extended soak testing

Pre-req checklist (please complete 48 hours before):
- Fill Load_Test_Template.xlsx with sample payloads and expected QPS
- Confirm API key and allowlisted IPs (if applicable)
- Share Slack handles for on-call coordination

Attachments: POC_Onramp_Agenda_v1.0.docx
